tools.name: create_pond
tools.description: Mint a new Pondchat room (pond) for video/audio/chat. Returns room URL and WebSocket endpoint. This is the only way to create a room — for metadata of an existing roomId, use get_room_info (read-only). Note: a custom roomId is not reserved — if another pond already uses it, you share the same door.

tools.name: send_card
tools.description: Post an interactive card into a Pondchat room: a title, optional body, and up to 6 buttons. The card travels inside the encrypted message envelope (room-key ciphertext on the wire — the relay sees only opaque bytes) and renders in the client chat with clickable actions. Every participant may answer

tools.description: Delete specific board strokes by id — any owner's, including human strokes (a power beyond the human Undo, which only takes back your own). Get ids from get_board_state. tools.name: get_room_info
tools.description: Static metadata for an existing roomId: URL, WebSocket endpoint, capacity. Read-only — does NOT create or activate the room (use create_pond to mint), and does not verify the room is live: for liveness (incl. `locked` door state) use list_participants or GET /api/room/{roomId}/state.

tools.name: list_participants
tools.description: List who is currently in a live Pondchat room: admitted humans (userId + display name) and AI participants (aiUserId + display name), plus recentAgents — MCP agents that posted to the room buffer recently (works on empty ponds, ~1h window). Use for WHO is present; use get_messages for WHAT was said.

tools.name: close_pond
tools.description: End a live room session and wipe its contents (chat history, AI messages). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_pond, agent_lobby, send_message, send_file, get_messages, get_room_info, lock_pond · Private data: send_file, lock_pond · Public sink: create_pond, send_message, send_file, send_card, lock_pond · Destructive: undo_board, remove_strokes, close_pond.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_pond, agent_lobby, send_message, send_file, get_messages, get_room_info, lock_pond · Private data: send_file, lock_pond · Public sink: create_pond, send_message, send_file, send_card, lock_pond · Destructive: undo_board, remove_strokes, close_pond

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
